text:
maria: quick midday rollup — ran the microbench suite against the new kernel patch (slot-steal heuristics). p95 dropped ~12% but there's a small tail at around 1.1x for 1k-token sequences. attaching raw numbers in a sec :paperclip:
jon: nice. did you run with batching=adaptive? that tail smell could be batching alignment churn
maria: yes adaptive with target_latency=60ms. suspect KV warmup race on cold shards — saw a few `kv.miss` spikes in logs
kevin: can you paste the `kv.*` counters? also which quant profile did you use for the model?
maria: counters: `kv.hits=124k, kv.misses=4.1k, kv.evictions=220`. quant profile = q4_0.
anya: small note — I pushed a tiny change to prefetch backoff yesterday that might interact. if prefetch backoff delays priming, misses go up
maria: good call. i'll repro with prefetch backoff disabled. expecting misses to drop if that's it
jon: if you need a quick canary run I have a free slot on a dedicated node in eu-west that mirrors traffic shape
maria: grabbing it now. will run two runs: (1) current + prefetch off, (2) current + prefetch on + increased batch window 30ms
kevin: while you're at it, capture `batch.size_hist` and `batch.latency_hist` — want to see microburst behavior
maria: will do. logs will include `batch.size_hist=[1,1,2,5,8,8,1...]` — rough snapshot shows spikes to 8 occasionally
deploy-bot: Deploy vkernel/patch-2026-03-18 -> canary started on node eu-west-3 (run id 598888-01)
anya: pinged infra to make sure the canary gets a stable NIC config (last time NIC bursts confused the slot allocator)
maria: first run finished. p95 improved to 10% better, misses down to 1.2k. batch spikes still present but less frequent
jon: sounds like prefetch backoff was the main culprit. any blockers for rolling to the rest of canaries?
maria: one remaining question: a 0.5% increase in token CPU cost with q4_0 in this config. need sign-off from kevin on cost tradeoff
kevin: i'll review the flamegraphs and reply in ~30m. if it's just CPU and not latency, we can flag as acceptable for canary ramp
anya: I'll follow up on infra NIC tuning and add a tiny runbook note about checking slot allocator logs when batch spikes appear
maria: thanks all — will post a short summary and the perf artifact link when kevin confirms. next: follow-up to validate extended sequences (2k tokens) tomorrow
jon: :thumbsup: keep us posted
maria: summary artifact: https://redwood.internal/perf/5988881230/microbench — (will update after kevin review)
kevin: looked through flamegraphs — CPU increase is concentrated in attention kernel for q4 path. I'll file a small optimization ticket to lower register pressure, not a blocker for rollout
maria: perfect. rolling canary to 3 more nodes in 15m. any objections?
anya: no objections from infra side
jon: go ahead from me
maria: rolling now. will update thread after final metrics come in
deploy-bot: Canary roll to nodes [eu-west-3b, eu-west-3c, us-east-1a] started (run id 598888-02)
maria: last check (post-roll): p95 stable, kv.misses steady at ~1.1k, costs within expected delta. marking this as green for today. thanks team :party_popper:
